items.text: In Canadian football, the Edmonton Elks defeat the Montreal Alouettes to win the Grey Cup .
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang resigns amidst allegations of being targeted by a Chinese spy and of having extramarital affairs.
The Salvadoran military intervention in Haiti intensifies with airstrikes on 400 Mawozo's alleged headquarters and a deployment to the Sylvio Cator Stadium.
American ocean liner SS United States is scuttled in the Gulf of Mexico to create the largest artificial reef.
